name: makersmcp
description: Free kits for makers in one MCP: brand kits, fonts, screenshots, demo videos, launch films and fitted music, made on your own machine.

interface.shortDescription: Free kits for makers, one MCP
interface.longDescription: Gives your agent the MakersMCP kits through one MCP server: a website's brand kit and fonts, clean screenshots and a demo video, a launch film with its pictures, a video check and music fitted to a cut. Everything runs on your machine with the Chrome and ffmpeg you have, with no account or key.
